column3: Ramesh's smile changed colour every year.
Chai in the morning. A cigarette at tea break. Gutka after lunch.
Then his daughter drew Papa, with brown teeth.
But the colour was hiding something worse.
Tartar builds up, full of germs, and tobacco makes it worse.
The germs attack the gums, and they slowly pull back.
Even the bone holding each tooth wears away.
At the dental clinic, a deep cleaning clears the tartar and stains.
Gum care helps them heal, and the team helps him quit, step by step.
So his daughter drew Papa again.
It's never too late. Book your gum check today.
